Emma — thanks for the usage file. Quick read-through makes the ask straightforward. I've sketched a concise options table and a few technical notes below; attaching a cost model draft for internal review. Happy to polish into the one-pager for procurement.

High-level packaging (starter names, not final):
- Trial Pilot (30–90d, credits): low friction, no commit, limited autoscale, includes Optimize Lite (batching/caching enabled, single-quant profile). Good for validation across teams.
- Committed Pilot (3–12 mo): commit to monthly token spend; unlock higher batching windows, KV cache size, and faster model variants. Includes one performance tuning session.
- Enterprise Optimize (annual): reserved capacity, guaranteed SLOs, custom quant profiles, priority rollout control, longer retention and audit exports.

How batching & KV caching affect your profile (short answer):
- For Skyline's high-QPS short prompts, batching increases throughput and reduces per-token GPU time by ~25–45% depending on burstiness.
- KV cache (prefix caching) will cut repeated-token recomputation on multi-turn flows; expect 15–35% token-savings for conversation-heavy flows if session affinity is high.

Quantization recommendations (practical guidance):
- Start with int8 (8-bit) quant for baseline: minimal latency gains, near-identical quality in our tests for generation tasks.
- Try mixed int8/int4 for non-critical models where cost is primary; expect larger token-cost reductions but regression risk on hallucination/creative outputs. We recommend a prompt-level eval set.
- For latency-sensitive endpoints, pair int8 quant + dynamic batching (small windows, 20–50ms) to keep tail latency predictable.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Internal: we (Priyom + Karthik + Neha) finalize cost model and three candidate price points for Trial/Committed/Enterprise by 3 PM PT.
2) External: 30-minute sync at 4 PM PT today to walk procurement through the decision matrix + highlight tradeoffs.

Attached: cost-model-v1.xlsx (workbook with scenario tabs).

Best,
Camila Reyes
